text:
Predicates:
LongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
Seasons(y) ::: y is a season.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Premises:
∀y (Seasons(y)) ::: There are four seasons in a year: Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ LongVacation(x) → FavoriteSeason(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
FavoriteSeason(mia, y) ⊕ FavoriteSeason(emma, y) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
LongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(james, summer) ::: James's favorite season is summer.
